zh: 修复账户菜单在页面缩放或窗口较矮时上方放不下、翻到账户行下方并盖住账户行的问题：上下都放不下的菜单留在空间更大的一侧，贴着窗口边缘展开。
en: Fix the account menu flipping below the account row and covering it when the page zoom or a short window leaves too little room above: a menu that fits on neither side stays on the roomier one, held against the window's edge.
